biography.value:
Description

A strange monster made from an amalgamation of various bones. Those who have perished gathered together in regret of the world to become this horrific reaper. Most of these people who gather into an ankou are those who died of famine, from cold, and other horrible deaths. Because ankous are born from places where the environment isn't very welcoming, such as beached ships and snowy mountains, the casualties reported by them is minimal. But, many trained monks take the lead in facing them to end their sad existence.

Defense

AC 22, touch 10, flat-footed 21 (+1 dex, +12 natural, -1 size)

hp 161 [221] (17d8+85)

Fort +10, Ref +8, Will +13

Defensive Abilities Channel Resistance +6; DR 10/bludgeoning and good; Immune Undead traits; Resist Ice 10

Weakness Fire and Holy

Offense

Speed 40 ft.

Melee Bite +19 (1d8+8), Sting +20 (1d8+8), Claw +19 (1d6+8), 2 Wings +17 (1d6+4)

Ranged 3 Ribs +12 (1d6+4) [60 feet]

Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (10 ft. Sting)

Special Attacks Ashen Blight, Bone Slash, Crypt Dust

Statistics

Str 26, Dex 12, Con -, Int 6, Wis 16, Cha 20

Base Atk +12; CMB +21; CMD 32

Feats Cleave, Devastating Strike, Great Cleave, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (Sting)

Skills Climb +13, Intimidate +13, Perception +12, Stealth +9

Languages Abyssal

description.value:
Pitting all of your strength and resolve against your enemy, you deliver a strike that is impossible to ignore.

Prerequisites: Vital Strike, base attack bonus +9.

Benefits: Whenever you use Vital Strike, Improved Vital Strike, or Greater Vital Strike, you gain a +2 bonus on each extra weapon damage dice roll those feats grant (+6 maximum). This bonus damage is multiplied on a critical hit.

Combat Trick

Whenever you use Vital Strike, Improved Vital Strike, or Greater Vital Strike, you can spend 5 stamina points to increase the bonus damage to +4 on each extra weapon damage die. For weapons with more than one damage die, count all of the weapon's base damage dice together as one set.

4/day, an ankou creates ash to erupt around it's foes. All enemies within 30 feet of the ankou suffer the effects of Blindga. (Will save DC 23) Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Religion DC 21).

effect: Give Ashen Blight: blinded to enemies that fail the save for [[@attributes.hd.total]] rounds (Blindga).

description.value: Once every 1d4+1 rounds as a swift action, an ankou can choose to focus it's energy and attack with it's sting and claw. The damage increases it's sting to 2d8+16/18-20 and it's claw to 2d6+16/18-20 damage each and it inflicts it during that round.

effect: For this round use the enhanced sting and claw, not both ordinary and enhanced attacks.

description.value: 2/day, an ankou throws dust upon it's foe within 15 feet away to inflict zombie status effect for 8 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Religion DC 25).

effect: On successful ranged touch, save negates Zombie for 8 rounds.
